description: Replace the task description card with per-instance game management.
find:
<dashboard:DashboardCard x:Name="IntroductionCard"
                                     CardId="task_desc"
                                     GridColumn="4"
                                     GridRow="5"
                                     GridColumnSpan="4"
                                     GridRowSpan="3"
                                     ExpandedColumnSpan="4"
                                     ExpandedRowSpan="3">
                <dashboard:DashboardCard.TitleContent>
                    <TextBlock FontSize="11"
                               FontWeight="Bold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource SukiLowText}"
                               Margin="2,0,0,0"
                               Text="{markup:I18n {x:Static helper:LangKeys.TaskDescription}}"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                </dashboard:DashboardCard.TitleContent>

                <mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer Focusable="True"
                                             x:Name="Introduction"
                                             Margin="10,5,10,5">
                    <mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer.Engine>
                        <extensions:MarkdownExtension />
                    </mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer.Engine>
                    <mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer.Styles>
                        <StyleInclude Source="avares://MFAAvalonia.Core/Assets/Style/MdXamlDocStyle.axaml" />
                    </mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer.Styles>
                    <mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer.Plugins>
                        <StaticResource ResourceKey="MdXamlPlugin" />
                    </mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer.Plugins>
                </mdxaml:MarkdownScrollViewer>

            </dashboard:DashboardCard>
replace:
<dashboard:DashboardCard x:Name="IntroductionCard"
                                     CardId="task_desc"
                                     GridColumn="4"
                                     GridRow="5"
                                     GridColumnSpan="4"
                                     GridRowSpan="3"
                                     ExpandedColumnSpan="4"
                                     ExpandedRowSpan="3">
                <dashboard:DashboardCard.TitleContent>
                    <TextBlock FontSize="14"
                               FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource SukiLowText}"
                               Margin="2,0,0,0"
                               Text="游戏管理"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                </dashboard:DashboardCard.TitleContent>

                <controls:GameManagementView Margin="10,5,10,5" />

            </dashboard:DashboardCard>
